_comment: Neural opponents for the expanded decision registry (task T0035). Every entry of the P-only catalogs is registered; the catalogs include each other and are merged by name (a name defined twice must be defined identically). Controls (unchanged carriers, no network) and hybrids (network mixed with the hand-written forecast) are not P-only or P+V entries and are listed as not registered. Entries whose model registry is missing (the V-pilot A-E wrappers) resolve as disabled with zero sampling mass; they are never compiled raw. Existing V-on opponents are allowed. A neural group takes the inventory lineage of its carrier's origin source. Future T0032 student or QAT exports need a separate admission entry here; the T0032 teacher is offline only. Log-only collection carriers (role decision_log, bots/p_only/profiles/variants_decision.json) are in the catalogs so the designated carrier resolves, and excluded as opponents.
